name: io.github.joleschmidt/palim
title: Palim
description: Hosted MCP memory server: save sessions and decisions once, search them from Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, and other MCP clients. EU-hosted. Explicit save + PostgreSQL full-text search (not embeddings).
